fusions.name: Strand Net
fusions.desc: Casts a net of fine strands ahead of you, dealing 9 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long, with a 40% chance per hit to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Strangling Filament
fusions.desc: Whips a weighted filament at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Prickling Mane
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Strand by Strand
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (38% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
